target.resolutionSource: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 1-Year Estimates Detailed Table B28005
target.resolutionRule: Resolve to 100 * B28005_017E / B28005_014E for geography United States in the first public 2025 ACS 1-Year Estimates Detailed Table B28005 print, rounded to one decimal percentage point. Use the original Census first-posted estimate and ignore later revisions or corrections unless Census replaces the first public file before the public release completes.
